name: Advanced Filesystem: AI Alt Text
description: Generates descriptive alt text for image files using the drupal/ai "Chat with Image Vision" operation. Adds a "Generate ALT with AI" button inside image field widgets, a per-file form, a batch generator, a JSON endpoint and a Drush command; writes the result into the alt sub-field of every image field that references the file.

suggests.drupal/ai: Provides the chat_with_image_vision operation this submodule calls; without a configured AI Vision provider the button/forms are inert.
suggests.ext-gd: Used by AltTextService::prepareImageForApi() to resize/normalise the image to a <=1024px JPEG before sending it to the vision API.

project_description: AI Alt Text is a submodule of Advanced Filesystem that automates writing accessible alt text for images. It delegates the actual vision inference to the drupal/ai module's default "Chat with Image Vision" provider (so no provider, model or API key is stored in this submodule), then trims the response to a configurable maximum length and writes it into the alt sub-field of every image field across the site that references the processed file. It surfaces the feature in four places: a "Generate ALT with AI" button injected into image field widgets (driven by a small fetch()-based JSON endpoint), a per-file form under the file listing, a site-wide batch generator, and a Drush command. A single config object holds the prompt, the max length and an overwrite-by-default flag; all administrative routes are gated behind a restricted permission, and generation behind a dedicated 'generate' permission.
